svg.title: Working together — freelance, remote, under NDA
svg.desc: Freelance, remote, under NDA. I take on AI and product work for clients worldwide — scoped up front, shipped in weekly steps. Services and typical timelines: AI agents & automations (1–4 weeks) — RAG, agents and multi-model systems on OpenAI + Claude, behind Cloudflare AI Gateway; Mobile apps (2–6 weeks) — Flutter for iOS & Android — auth, Firebase, Razorpay / Stripe, store release; Backend APIs (1–3 weeks) — .NET Web API or Node.js — auth, security alerting, fully documented; Full-stack MVPs (3–8 weeks) — Mobile + backend + AI + security, deployed on Azure + Cloudflare; how I work: NDA-friendly — Happy to sign one — client work stays private. Remote, worldwide — IST (UTC+5:30), async-friendly, replies within 24 hours. Your code, delivered — Weekly deliverables and full source handoff, no scope surprises. Email me about a project: harshbhx@gmail.com.
